fingerprintVerification.purpose: Independent read-only source fingerprint, frozen input, and paired iOS ZIP audit

sourceFingerprint.method: SHA256 of UTF8 area-target-source-v1 newline, then for every source frame in order: ASCII canonical byte length colon plus Foundation sortedKeys JSON canonical bytes; ASCII image byte length colon plus binary SHA256(image bytes). Finish UTF8 model: plus ASCII model byte length colon plus binary SHA256(model.obj bytes). Canonical frame carries index and timestamp as Double, original transform array, fx/fy/cx/cy as Doubles, width/height as Doubles, and orientation or legacy landscapeLeft fallback. Paths and raw poses/intrinsics JSON encoding do not enter identity. Swift standalone canonical serialization only; independent Python streaming SHA256 accumulation.

fairness.legacyOrientationNote: Raw poses have no imageOrientation; raw source fingerprint canonical fallback is landscapeLeft. Both archived manifests equally add landscapeRight using the existing legacy archive behavior. This did not create a difference between controls.

independentEightRunNativeAudit.scope: All completed selected raw/Pillow and iOS CG native replay groups as listed in runs; no native API called and no replay run started. DBs opened mode=ro immutable.

protocol.numericTypeReason: JSONDecoder Int accepts integral float tokens such as 1.0/1e0. JSONSerialization preserves NSNumber floating storage, so raw critical-extension validation rejects floating and boolean numeric fields before Decodable; older fields are not changed.
